Branch cursor/u21-broadcast-read-span-d1bc — U21 shipped, do not look on master.

BroadcastRead per-minute is count/fight_seconds*60. Span field is SPAN_KEY ("span"); R82 will write it. Absent span falls back to 14.0. The U21 GATE assertion (written first) freezes U19's fixture bytes; a log with no span field matches it. span=14 matches; span=7 moves the rates.

C63 has not landed — ImpactModel.gd was not on master. _per_minute is inlined exactly as TASK_C63 specifies (0.0 when fight_seconds <= 0.0). Reconcile to ImpactModel.per_minute when C63 ships. No preload. Did not touch HANDOFF.md; digest at research/U21_DIGEST.md.
